sets.name: Royal Keepsakes
sets.tag: A LITTLE PIECE OF THE CASTLE
sets.description: Seals, coins and royal keepsakes. My pick for the castle story.
subjects: a red round wax seal with gently scalloped wax edge and one simple embossed four-point sparkle symbol
an orange copper coin, round with a thick beveled rim and one simple centered diamond symbol
a purple diamond gemstone, chunky cut-diamond silhouette with flat top, broad shoulders and pointed bottom, simple facets
a blue royal shield, broad pentagonal silhouette, subtle lighter blue central panel
a green feather, chunky curved plume with a short stem and two simple cut notches
a yellow royal bell with a small round handle and visible clapper
sets.prompt:
Transparent background. A production sprite sheet of exactly SIX separate match-3 game icons on a true transparent RGBA canvas, 1536 x 1024 landscape. Arrange a strict 3-column by 2-row grid, one icon in each equal square cell, centered with generous empty transparent gutters. Objects fill 72% of each cell. No labels, no borders, no interface, no background, no shadows on a surface.
Art style: the same excellent modern Bold Cartoon mobile-game icon family across all six objects: thick dark indigo outlines with rounded joins (about 3% of object width), chunky charming slightly asymmetric silhouettes, simple flat cel shading with at most three solid colour tones per material, one or two small crisp graphic highlights. Punchy saturated colours, friendly storybook feel, high clarity at 32 pixels. No 3D rendering, no realistic texture, no painterly brush strokes, no metallic photorealism, no white sticker borders. Front view or very slight three-quarter view. Details must be few, broad and bold.
Read left to right, top row first. Exact colour sequence: RED, ORANGE, PURPLE; BLUE, GREEN, YELLOW. Each icon should overwhelmingly read as its specified colour. Absolutely no crowns, butterflies or heart-shaped lockets. No text or numbers. 
Cell 1: a red round wax seal with gently scalloped wax edge and one simple embossed four-point sparkle symbol.
Cell 2: an orange copper coin, round with a thick beveled rim and one simple centered diamond symbol.
Cell 3: a purple diamond gemstone, chunky cut-diamond silhouette with flat top, broad shoulders and pointed bottom, simple facets.
Cell 4: a blue royal shield, broad pentagonal silhouette, subtle lighter blue central panel.
Cell 5: a green feather, chunky curved plume with a short stem and two simple cut notches.
Cell 6: a yellow royal bell with a small round handle and visible clapper.
This six-icon collection is called Royal Keepsakes; do not write its name in the artwork. Final image background is actual alpha transparency, not a picture of a transparent-background pattern.
